jei.voltworks_quarry.info.quarry.1: Digs out the 9x9 area behind it (its front faces you when placed), layer by layer, from its own height down to the bottom of the world.
jei.voltworks_quarry.info.quarry.2: Needs Voltworks power through Copper Cable: 20 J/t while digging. Harder blocks take longer. Bedrock is skipped, water and lava are cleared, and chests in the way are emptied into the output.
jei.voltworks_quarry.info.quarry.3: Fills any chest next to it by itself; Voltworks item pipes pull from it too. A redstone signal pauses it. Takes Range, Fortune and Silk Touch upgrades, plus the Voltworks Speed, Capacity and Ejector upgrades.
Quarry upgrade: makes the pit 8 blocks wider for each one (9x9, 17x17, 25x25, up to 33x33 with three). The quarry restarts from the top; dug-out air is skipped quickly.
jei.voltworks_quarry.info.fortune_upgrad: Quarry upgrade: one level of Fortune for each one, up to Fortune III. Each level uses 50% more power. Silk Touch overrides it.
Sets the area a Quarry digs. Put one marker touching the Quarry and another at the opposite corner; the Quarry picks both up and digs the rectangle between them, corners included, from its own height down.
The area can be up to 9 blocks wide and long, or 17, 25 or 33 with one, two or three Range Upgrades. Right-click a marker to see which marker it pairs with.
jei.voltworks_quarry.info.silk_touch_upg: Quarry upgrade: mined blocks drop themselves (stone, ores, grass). Uses double power and overrides Fortune.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.1:
Voltworks Quarry
@items voltworks_quarry:quarry voltworks_quarry:drill_head
Digs a square pit behind it, layer by layer, down to bedrock.

The front faces you; the pit starts at the back.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.2:
Setting Up

Power it with Copper Cable: 20 J/t while digging (tier 2 power: two Generators, Thermal or a Reactor).

Put a chest on any side: the quarry fills it by itself. Item pipes work too.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.3:
How It Digs

9x9, from the quarry's height down. Harder blocks take longer.

Bedrock is skipped. Water and lava are cleared. Chests in the way are emptied into the output.

A redstone signal pauses it.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.4:
Marking an Area

@items voltworks_quarry:quarry_marker
To dig somewhere else, put a Quarry Marker touching the quarry and another at the opposite corner.

The quarry picks both up and digs the rectangle between them, corners included.

Up to 9 across, 17/25/33 with Range upgrades.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.5:
Upgrades

@items voltworks_quarry:range_upgrade voltworks_quarry:fortune_upgrade voltworks_quarry:silk_touch_upgrade
Range: +8 wide (up to 33x33).
Fortune: one level each, up to III, +50% power.
Silk Touch: blocks drop themselves, double power.

Speed, Capacity and Ejector upgrades work too.
guide.voltworks_quarry.page.6:
Tips

The GUI shows the layer, size and blocks mined.

Turning the quarry, a Range upgrade or a new marked area restarts from the top; dug-out air is skipped fast.

Keep cables and chests outside a marked area, or the quarry digs them up.

Right-click a marker to see its partner. To go back to the square behind it, pick the quarry up and place it again.

Keep the area's chunks loaded.
